description: Computational Complexity Theory axioms and open conjectures

axioms.name: Halting Problem Undecidability
axioms.statement: No algorithm can determine whether an arbitrary program will halt
axioms.formal: ¬∃ algorithm H: ∀ program P, input I: H(P, I) = halts(P, I)

axioms.name: Comparison Sort Lower Bound
axioms.statement: Comparison-based sorting requires Ω(n log n) comparisons in the worst case
violations: comparison sort faster than n log n

open_conjectures.name: P vs NP Conjecture
open_conjectures.statement: It is unknown whether P = NP or P ≠ NP
open_conjectures.implication: Claims to solve NP-complete problems in polynomial time should be FLAGGED, not rejected

open_conjectures.name: Integer Factoring Hardness
open_conjectures.statement: It is unknown whether integer factoring is in P
open_conjectures.implication: Claims to factor in polynomial time should be FLAGGED
